text:
leo: Quick heads-up — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2245 that changes the auth header shape (adding X-RDWD-AUTH-VERSION and separating tenant). Need SDK bump + console tweak. Plan to merge in tomorrow's merge window unless blockers.

sam: Saw it, thanks. SDK has a small compatibility shim but we need CI + tests. I can draft an SDK PR and bump semver. tagging @jen for console impact.

jen: Thanks @sam @leo — console reads the header in auth-service and the helm chart needs a config flag. I can land a console PR after SDK publishes. Is this a hard break?

leo: Not a hard break — runtime will accept the old header if the version is missing, but routing is better with the explicit version. Recommend rollout order: SDK -> API -> Console, and a canary in us-west-2.

maria: Runtime team sanity-checked backward compat. One note: KV cache routing benefits from the version header to avoid tenant mix in corner cases. We'll accept both for ~48h then enforce. I'll open an internal ticket to track.

tim: Timeline ok. Can we get an SDK draft by EOD? Also please add a short runbook entry and mention in release notes.

sam: I'll push the SDK draft in ~2h: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/98. Tests will run across node12/14/16. Migration snippet I'll include in the PR: 

```js
// old
headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
// new
headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
headers['X-RDWD-AUTH-VERSION'] = 'v2';
```

leo: Perfect. @ops-bot can you schedule a staging canary once SDK and API PRs are merged?

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for "api" in staging in 30m. CI: build passed: https://ci.redwood/2245/build/102 :white_check_mark:

jen: FYI I added a UI feature flag to toggle versioned auth for rollout. Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/810

sam: pinging reviewers @alex @nina on sdk-js PR.

alex: Reviewing now. small nit about header casing in tests but lgtm overall.

nina: Approved, left one comment asking for an extra unit test around tenant parsing.

leo: Great — plan: SDK merge by 08:30 PT, API merge at ~09:45 PT tomorrow, then console after canary verification. I'll post a short update in #eng-oncall when we start the API merge.

tim: Noted and added REL-123 to releases board: https://company.atlassian.net/browse/REL-123.

leo: Thanks everyone — let's keep PR links updated as we move. :thumbsup:
